title: Maryland Hospital Global Budget Revenue Dataset
description:
A versioned, machine-readable compilation of Maryland Health Services Cost Review Commission (HSCRC) public reports on the state's all-payer hospital global budget system. Fourteen tables, 314,131 rows, covering FY2005 to FY2026.

Includes hospital revenue and volume by month, rate center, setting, payer and patient residence for FY2017 to FY2026; approved global budget targets (rate years 2019 to 2026) and quality program revenue adjustments (rate years 2016 to 2027); statewide and hospital-level financial condition for FY2005 to FY2025, extracted from HSCRC's annual PDF reports; a hospital crosswalk linking HSCRC hospital numbers to CMS Certification Numbers and every observed name; and a sourced reference table of rate center codes. Every column is defined in the data dictionary, every source document is named in the source manifest, and every decision linking a printed report name to a hospital is recorded with its evidence.

An interactive tracker built on this dataset is at https://farzinahmadi.github.io/maryland-gbr-tracker/
